python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,shutil,pathlib,json,os,struct
root=pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000130/out/archive/contact');out=pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT']);report=[]
def dump(c):
 r={}
 for name,sql in c.execute("select name,sql from sqlite_master where type='table'"):
  esc='"'+name.replace('"','""')+'"';cur=c.execute('select * from '+esc);rows=cur.fetchall()
  r[name]={'sql':sql,'columns':[a[0] for a in cur.description],'count':len(rows),'rows':[[{'blob_hex':v.hex()} if isinstance(v,bytes) else v for v in row] for row in rows]}
 return r
for label,rel in [('apex','apex.sqlite3'),('nucleus','instance1/sync/nucleus.sqlite3')]:
 src=root/rel;wal=pathlib.Path(str(src)+'-wal');d=out/label;d.mkdir();db=d/src.name;shutil.copyfile(src,db);shutil.copyfile(wal,str(db)+'-wal')
 wb=wal.read_bytes();page=struct.unpack_from('>I',wb,8)[0];step=24+page;frames=(len(wb)-32)//step;assert (len(wb)-32)%step==0
 commits=[{'frame':i+1,'page_number':struct.unpack_from('>I',wb,32+i*step)[0],'db_size_pages':struct.unpack_from('>I',wb,36+i*step)[0]} for i in range(frames) if struct.unpack_from('>I',wb,36+i*step)[0]]
 base=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(src)+'?mode=ro&immutable=1',uri=True);b=dump(base);base.close()
 c=sqlite3.connect(str(db));q=c.execute('pragma quick_check').fetchall();j=c.execute('pragma journal_mode').fetchone()[0];s=dump(c);backup=sqlite3.connect(str(d/'committed-snapshot.sqlite3'));c.backup(backup);backup.close();c.close()
 json.dump({'immutable_base':b,'committed_snapshot':s},open(d/'all-rows.json','w'),indent=2)
 report.append({'label':label,'sqlite_version':sqlite3.sqlite_version,'wal_length':len(wb),'page_size':page,'frames':frames,'commits':commits,'journal_mode':j,'snapshot_quick_check':q,'base_counts':{k:v['count'] for k,v in b.items()},'snapshot_counts':{k:v['count'] for k,v in s.items()},'changed_tables':[k for k in set(b)|set(s) if b.get(k)!=s.get(k)]})
json.dump(report,open(out/'wal-reconstruction.json','w'),indent=2);print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
PY
